pages.text: $(bold)Description:$() OBSR-3 is the candidate body of an observer. It provides no protection, restricts no drift, and takes part in no local stabilisation work; it is responsible only for accumulating semantics, until it can perform an observation of its own.
pages.title: OBSR-3
Construction
pages.text: Built around an $(bold)activated OBSR-EX$(). The previous iteration's complete classifier is sealed in the centre, with prototypes, eyes of ender and a nether star around it.$(br2)Crafting consumes that OBSR-EX.

$(bold)Accumulation:$()$(br2)$(li)1. Hold OBSR-3 and right-click blocks or creatures to record their readings.$(br)$(li)2. Combine a semantic fragment with OBSR-3 to write the fragment's semantics directly into the candidate.$(br2)Both methods count toward progress; each distinct entry counts only once.
pages.title: Accumulation

pages.text: OBSR-3 does not go through the Training Terminal and has no record table limit. Progress can be read from the item tooltip.$(br2)A fragment is consumed when it is used to inject knowledge. The seven fragments together are not enough to complete the candidate on their own.

$(bold)Completed state:$() once progress is full, OBSR-3 counts as complete.$(br2)$(li)It has the total stability effect of OBSR-EX and can be placed directly into a base;$(br)$(li)it is the only executing component of the refocus operation.$(br2)OBSR-3 cannot be duplicated.
